description: This file defines a module for generating PowerPoint presentations programmatically using the 'pptxgenjs' library. It includes functions for handling image data URLs, applying transformations to data, resolving template placeholders, rendering fixed shapes, and ultimately creating a PPTX document with slides based on provided templates, layout models, and user data.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a probable data URL, i.e., starts with 'data:'.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or string to a data URL, returning null if conversion fails or input is invalid.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a resource from a URL and converts it into a data URL, returning null on failure.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specific transformations ('bulletsToLines', 'formatPercent', 'formatCurrency') to input values for presentation formatting.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Generates a deck title from global data, defaulting to 'presentation' if no suitable name is found.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to create a safe filename, replacing spaces with dashes and removing invalid characters.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate value for a given slide step and field from the wizard data, considering context scope.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches (used because PPTX uses inches for positioning).

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder text with a label and optional value to a slide when no data is available.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds an image placeholder with a label; uses data URL conversion for image files or URLs.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed shapes onto slides, including images and rectangles or rounded rectangles.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that generates a PPTX Blob based on template models, extracted template data, slide order, and wizard data.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
